name: @hostelmitra/api

scripts.// build: tsconfig.build.json, not tsconfig.json: the latter emits to dist/src/ (breaking npm start) and compiles tests and the seed into the artifact. See NEW-1 and NEW-2.
scripts.// start: npm run build must run first. Verified in CI by actually booting the artifact, not just compiling it.

// dependencies: EXACT pins on @prisma/client and prisma, unlike every other entry. H-6: the Prisma CLI advisory covers 6.13.0-dev.1 .. 8.1.0-dev.4, and 6.12.0 sits BELOW that range, so downgrading both packages clears it. npm labels the fix isSemVerMajor because that is its heuristic for any non-forward version move, not a statement that a major upgrade is required. 6.12.0 was verified against the full test suite. Keep the two packages on the same version — Prisma generates a client that must match its CLI.
// removed: bcryptjs and multer were removed (NEW-3). Both had zero references in src/, prisma/ and tests/. Password hashing is not implemented — OTP login is the only mechanism — and uploads go to disk via the existing static route rather than through multer. Keeping unused packages installed means carrying their CVEs for no benefit.
